campaign_name: PR-PLAY-04 Opening Failure Acceptance and Commit Integrity
purpose: A campaign opening either completes from an accepted scene_opening or fails explicitly without gameplay progression.
objective_status: B — CONDITIONAL ACCEPTANCE; HOST REPAIR DEMONSTRATED; LIVE GENERATION UNPROVEN
executive_summary: Failure class: implementation. A rejected scene_opening was sealed as safe_nonresolution and committed as a successful opening, and opening progression was saved before acceptance. The repair keeps that generic fallback from completing scene_opening and restores turn, time pressure, and faction state unless a valid opening is accepted. Pre-change stubs reproduced both defects. Post-change stubs and 18 integration tests pass. Structured validation, prompts, schemas, models, token limits, and PR-PLAY-02 admission controls were not weakened. Two legacy HTTP tests that treated '[Narration]' as a completed opening now receive HTTP 422. Three rich-opening length assertions still fail at gate length 781 and were not bisected. The accounting fingerprint test remains red on the preexisting dirty tree. No live provider call. Verdict B. Live playtesting may not resume.
